summary: Completed a one-time backfill import that wrote 135 segments (9,666 messages across 94 sessions) from pi-archive and claude-code sources into the project's .agent-journal directory, verifying the index.jsonl line count and frontmatter metadata.
decisions: Leave .agent-journal/ unignored in .gitignore so it can be committed as shared team knowledge (per user's choice).
Segment identity is keyed by source entry ids, making re-runs idempotent and import-only-new.
